payload.productNameEn: Handmade Willow Wicker Planter Basket Boho Rustic Home Decor
payload.categoryName: Home, Garden & Furniture/Festive & Party Supplies/Decorative Flowers & Wreaths
payload.description:
Enhance your home with the rustic charm of our handmade woven planters. Crafted from natural willow, these beautiful baskets bring a touch of bohemian and farmhouse style to any room. Available in two versatile colors—a warm Honey and a rich, earthy Brown—they are perfect for showcasing your favorite indoor plants.

Each planter includes a durable plastic liner, making it easy to house your potted plants without worrying about leaks. The intricate weave adds texture and warmth, turning any simple plant into a stunning decorative piece.

Beyond being a stylish pot cover, this versatile basket can also be used for storing small items on a shelf, organizing your desk, or as a charming centerpiece on your dining table. It's an ideal gift for plant lovers, a thoughtful housewarming present, or a lovely treat for yourself.

Key Features:

Material: High-quality natural willow

Colors: Available in Natural and Brown

Liner: Comes with a built-in plastic liner to protect surfaces

Style: Boho, Rustic, Farmhouse, Natural

Dimensions: Height: 7 inches (18cm), Top Diameter: 10 inches (26cm)

Choose your favorite color or get both to create a beautiful, coordinated display in your living room, bedroom, or office.
